items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Sunday; status crucial for DFS main slate and Ravens offense.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury dump; Rapoport notes Jackson 'headed in the right direction'.
items.implication: Game-time lean; Huntley if out. Boosts Flowers/Andrews if active.

items.text: Puka Nacua QUESTIONABLE (calf); took majority practice Thursday but will test pregame. McVay: lacked power/explosion.
items.why: ETR dump + McVay comments via Rapoport/Levitan.
items.implication: GTD; absence funnels to TEs/WRs with Adams already OUT.
items.opportunity: If out, Higbee lead target hierarchy

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) after limited return to practice; status key vs Dolphins.
items.why: ETR Sunday dump; Berry notes if active start him.
items.implication: If plays, start; else Braelon Allen RB1 upside.
items.opportunity: High touch share if cleared vs MIA

items.text: Mike Evans ruled OUT (Achilles); Shanahan confirm via Rapoport. Schefter official outs list.
items.why: ETR OUT list + coach confirm + Schefter photo list.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps depleted; more funnel to Kittle/CMC.

items.text: Deebo Samuel OUT; listed with Evans in ETR dump and Schefter outs.
items.implication: Further thins SF pass catchers; elevates Kittle funnel and CMC slot usage.

items.text: Davante Adams OUT (hamstring, multi-week); ETR and Schefter confirm.
items.why: ETR dump + Schefter list; prior multi-week projection.
items.implication: Rams TE target share spikes (was 37% in prior Puka-out games); Higbee preferred short-term.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE usage with Puka also Q

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT; featured in Schefter outs photo and ETR list.
items.implication: KC WR hierarchy shifts; Worthy/others elevate.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love OUT (high-ankle); coach LaFleur ruled out, ETR/Schefter/Rap confirm.
items.implication: ARI RB depth thins; next man up volume.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT; ETR and Schefter lists.
items.implication: HOU/DET backfield (per listing) shifts volume to other RBs.

items.text: Tyler Warren OUT; ETR and Schefter lists (sneaky important scratch per Levitan).
items.why: ETR/Schefter; Levitan flags as missed scratch.
items.implication: IND TE/pass game adjusts; other TEs/WRs benefit.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN; allowed facility access earlier. Levitan notes backups Lloyd/Johnson poor EPA.
items.why: ETR IN list; Levitan facility context.
items.implication: Reclaims RB role; Berry hates due to layoff questions vs DET.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps if fully ramped

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most). Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob OUT confirmed; recent SF RB receptions data (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.implication: Bijan bellcow + receiving upside vs soft DvP.

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on 68.8% routes; Kmet IR (season-ending knee) may cut 2-/3-TE sets, juicing Burden route rate further.
items.why: YPRR data + Kmet IR (Rapoport/Johnson confirm season-ending).
items.implication: Higher route share/WR2-3 ceiling with Loveland also elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased routes in 11 personnel; targets vs reduced multi-TE

items.implication: TB WR depth impacted; opens snaps/targets elsewhere.
